name: Lisette
description: SD Lightning model with two-phase refinement architecture and 'dense diffusion' style regional prompting.

variables.name: Iteration
variables.description: How many steps to take to produce the render—more steps take more time but result in a more refined render.

variables.name: Adherence
variables.description: How much to follow model geometry via ControlNet depth.

variables.name: Mask Softness
variables.description: How much to soften material prompt masks—softer masks apply to wider areas; harder ones are more constrained.

provenance.data_provenance_notes: RealVisXL V5.0 is an SDXL Lightning checkpoint merge by SG_161222 combining multiple models such as DreamShaper XL, Juggernaut XL, Noosphere, and HelloWorld XL to achieve high photorealism across SFW and NSFW content.
